title: Handwritten Album Cover
coreRelationships: The handwritten text is the primary visual element, dominating the composition.
The praying hands illustration provides a small, contrasting detail to the raw text.
The parental advisory label acts as a standard, formal counterpoint to the informal handwriting.
The black text and illustrations stand out sharply against the white background.
reuseFormula: Recreate the high-contrast black-on-white composition. The main text must be custom-lettered to mimic a thick marker, exhibiting slight irregularities in form, baseline, and rotation. Include a small, detailed praying hands illustration centered at the bottom and a standard Parental Advisory label in the bottom right.
